_comment: Hand-curated extra answers for questions whose USCIS bracketed note declares
The import script REFUSES to machine-parse an 'Also acceptable are ...' note
and fails the build unless the question appears here. Mis-reading such a note
would silently reject answers USCIS accepts, and that failure would be
invisible -- it looks like the user simply got it wrong.
Each entry records the exact note it was derived from, so a reviewer can
check the transcription without opening the PDF.

120.note: Also acceptable are New Jersey, near New York City, and on the Hudson (River).
